_source: Obelisk Total Resources Calculator v7.2, sheet 'Bombs'. True time = base / bomb_recharge_speed / game_speed_multi.

bombs.name: Bomb of Plenty
bombs.effect: Marks ores to give more ores; chance to turn ores golden

bombs.name: Exp Bomb
bombs.effect: Marks ores to give more exp

bombs.name: MEGABOMB
bombs.effect: Marks ores to take more damage

bombs.name: Infinity Bomb
bombs.effect: Increases damage multi per infinity bomb fired

bombs.name: Transmuter Bomb
bombs.effect: Marks ores to drop bars; chance to apply a Bomb of Plenty stack

bombs.name: Gem Bomb
bombs.effect: Chance to get a gem when fired

bombs.name: Cherry Bomb
bombs.effect: Next bomb fired will not consume a charge; chance for triple charge

bombs.name: Battery Bomb
bombs.effect: Charges 2 random bombs; 0.1% chance to raise bomb capacity by 1

bombs.name: D20 Bomb
bombs.effect: 5% chance to refill other bomb charges

bombs.name: Founder's Bomb
bombs.effect: 10% chance to give 10 seconds of 2x game speed

bombs.name: Veinmorpher Bomb
bombs.effect: Chance to morph all ores to veins; chance to make all veins golden
